items.title: Incyte bolsters haematology portfolio in $2bn Vega buyout
items.summary: This acquisition will see Incyte absorb Vega's bleeding disorder candidate, VG039, which is in Phase III for von Willebrand disease (VWD).

items.title: Roche signs $2.3bn blood cancer drug agreement with Nurix Therapeutics
items.summary: Roche believes its new BTK-degrader bexobrutideg will outperform approved BTK-inhibitors in B-cell malignancies.

items.title: ADA26: key obesity readouts from the conference
items.summary: Key obesity data from Eli Lilly, Boehringer Ingelheim and Sciwind Biosciences captivated ADA 2026 attendees.

items.title: Sanofi and Owkin partner to develop next-generation biopharma AI agents
items.summary: Sanofi has entered a multi-year agreement with Paris-based agentic AI company Owkin to co-develop next-generation AI-driven biopharma agents.

items.title: EC grants marketing authorisation for IntraBio’s Aqneursa
items.summary: The European Commission (EC) has granted marketing authorisation for IntraBio’s Aqneursa to treat neurological symptoms of NPC.
